title: Pottery Classes (8 Weeks)

services.name: Wheel throwing
services.desc: Our 8-week wheel throwing class is designed for beginners, returning students, and anyone who wants to feel more confident working with clay. Whether this is your first time on the wheel or you are looking to strengthen your technique, this class offers a structured, encouraging introduction to the pottery process. Each week includes a new demonstration, guided instruction, and time to practice at your own pace. You will learn how to centre clay, throw functional forms, trim your work, add handles and lids, and finish your pieces with glaze.
